policySeparation: Source membership and inferred tags are evidence only. Human promoted, scenery-only, and blocked policies remain separate.

sources.name: net-art.org
sources.recommendation: Use as a research index; review every destination individually.
sources.notes: Broad historical index with varied availability and content suitability.

sources.name: PlayHTML examples
sources.recommendation: Eligible reserve entries; cap at one PlayHTML route per ride.
sources.notes: Repo-owned public examples and social experiments.

sources.name: Rhizome Archive
sources.recommendation: Review live browser-native works; exclude wrappers requiring emulation.
sources.notes: Historical archive with mixed live, preserved, and emulated experiences.

sources.name: SFPC HTTPoetics anthologies
sources.recommendation: Bulk-enable anthology works after public-page and health checks.
sources.notes: Class anthologies of small websites built around the poetics of the web.

sources.name: Taper
sources.recommendation: Bulk-enable individual works after public-page and health checks.
sources.notes: Edited literary magazine for small computational pieces.

sources.name: The HTML Review
sources.recommendation: Bulk-enable individual works after public-page and health checks.
sources.notes: Annual edited journal whose works are made to exist on the web.

sources.name: The NEXT
sources.recommendation: Review individual live works; do not bulk-enable archive records.
sources.notes: Deep museum-scale collection with emulated, archival, and live-web material.

sources.name: Whitney Artport
sources.recommendation: Review commissions individually for browser compatibility.
sources.notes: Museum portal containing commissions, exhibitions, and historical resources.

humanCommunitySources.name: 32-Bit Cafe
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Use official projects and staff-curated resources, not a presumed member directory.
humanCommunitySources.notes: The community intentionally does not equate forum participation with endorsement of personal sites.

humanCommunitySources.name: Discourse Discover
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Use as a broad lead source; review public access, topic quality, and commercial ownership per forum.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Optional platform directory spans community-owned spaces, product support, large companies, and gated forums.

humanCommunitySources.name: HTML Day / HTML Energy
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Trust official event and showcase pages; review participant submissions.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Stewarded, recurring gatherings where people make and share HTML together.

humanCommunitySources.name: HTML Energy e2e
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Use as a fresh discovery feed with per-item review, not as an allowlist.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Community-submitted links have strong event context but light editorial filtering.

humanCommunitySources.name: IndieWeb community
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Use stewarded event/showcase pages; do not bulk-ingest the open people directory.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Useful community provenance, but wiki participation is not a destination-quality verdict.

humanCommunitySources.name: Neocities featured sites
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Sample featured sites into review; never bulk-enable browse or recent-update feeds.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Large open host with useful featured signals but inconsistent content and safety.

humanCommunitySources.name: netdir
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Review the small curated ring, then enable exact homepages selectively.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Small handpicked ring with clear editorial stewardship.

humanCommunitySources.name: Socratica Webring
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Review exact member homepages; preserve Socratica provenance.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Stable community-specific list rather than a general open directory.

humanCommunitySources.name: Tildeverse members
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Enable reviewed community roots; treat scraped user homepages as a separate noisy source.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Member communities have stability, reputation, collaboration, and conduct requirements.

humanCommunitySources.name: webring.fun
humanCommunitySources.recommendation: Strong discovery source; health-check and review external member sites.
humanCommunitySources.notes: Has explicit personal, non-commercial, mostly-SFW, and anti-harassment membership rules.
